speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern, but I must ask a few more specific questions to ensure an accurate diagnosis before I can provide you with a final answer. Has this mass appeared in either of your lymph nodes, such as under your arm? REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound of the breast and axilla.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the ultrasound results; since there are no enlarged lymph nodes and the mass is growing rapidly without skin or nipple changes, I need to know your age and whether you are currently pregnant or breastfeeding to narrow down the differential. text: RESULTS: Breast MRI with contrast: Enhancing smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast; no evidence of lymph node involvement or contralateral disease.
